remarks: This newly constructed home features 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, and brand-new appliances—perfect for first-timebuyers or those continuing their homeownership journey. Thoughtfully designed for modern living, the home offers comfort, efficiency, and a functional one-story layout. Located on a neighborhood street with convenient access to public transportation, this property provides both accessibility and a strong sense of community. PLEASE READ CAREFULLY: This is an income-restricted, owner-occupied opportunity. Buyers must meet program eligibility requirements including a gross household income of $81,960 or less, and total household assets of less than $100,000. This home is currently available on a first-come, first-served basis. The purchase price of$175,000 is fixed and is not negotiable. The first applicant who meets all eligibility requirements and submits required documentation will be given the opportunity to purchase the home. Taxes are estimated based on a$175,000 sale price and 2027 City of Buffalo and Erie County tax rates. Building Buffalo Roots is a public partnership between the City of Buffalo, Erie County, and the region’s LandBank (BENLIC), to build new homes on vacant lots – expanding homeownership opportunities & strengthening neighborhoods.   DELAYED SHOWINGS: Showings begin Sept. 12, 2026 at 11 AM. Applications/offers begin Sept. 12, 2026 at 2 PM.
